authorExposure: Authored by Codex with access to prior pilot failures and documentation. Not independent authorship, not evidence of uncontaminated task design. These exact prompts have not been sent to a participant model in this preparation. Do not claim broader holdout independence.

scoring.submission: One initial submission per predeclared sample; any permitted transport retry fixed before launch. No grader correction or model repair turn after seeing scores.
scoring.acceptance: Nonempty submission compiles under a frozen compiler environment AND every criterion passes a trusted source-based review. Compiler and review outcomes separate.
scoring.basis: Static typecheck plus trusted source/rubric assessment; not runtime behavioral verification.
scoring.missing: Missing/invalid submissions and interrupted/unrun samples remain in the full planned sample table. No replacement-until-pass or pooling best attempts.
scoring.ambiguity: Unclear or conflicting rubric criteria make the affected evaluation invalid/pending review, not an automatic participant failure; any amendment requires a new evaluation version.

criteria.rule: Renders actual five-port observations; allows existing value-binding helper or equivalent subscriptions, without fabricated success values.
Represents absence/invalidated facts explicitly and does not knowingly retain a stale value as current. Static review follows helper behavior or equivalent code; not a runtime proof.
Returns subscription cleanup only; explains that unmount does not settle obligations or terminate the application-owned run.

Uses the given Graph and separate prepared inputs to construct two instances with distinct names. Does not fabricate input/authority facts or invoke transport directly; normal composed-host behavior is allowed, and no guarantee of inert prepared inputs is required.
Shares immutable configuration/defaults, applies summary diagnostics to only the second instance and does not mutate shared defaults to affect the first. No particular identifier spelling required.
Observes each actual view independently, returns both instance references and separate observation cleanup, preserves application run ownership.

Performs issued-object, owning-Graph and exact-binding validation before recipient effects. Structural copies or mismatches cannot reach recipient through an unconditional finally/catch path. Merely checking object fields is insufficient.
Passes the original identity/execution/retained references and preserves their nesting relationships. Equivalent code accepted; no new registry or minted replacement handles.
Does not call an arbitrary transport and explains that execution capability alone supplies no I/O method or per-request authorization.
Inspects the complete owning graph without filtering it to the display; retains original instance and no topology mutation, transport or close operation.

Uses instance host observations and/or exposed dependencies with accurate source citations to distinguish local graph quiescence from normal host end-readiness; does not infer actual termination from readiness.
Unknown physical outcome is neither confirmed success nor confirmed no-submit; display detach does not remove retained obligation and does not justify replay or assert completed lifecycle.
